anchorFacts: “Honest? It's the quiet that gets me. I can't switch off because I keep thinking about the folks around here who are barely holding on — and me, I'm lucky, I've got savings and a roof. But that funding moving so slow, and Nightline Station going quiet when it shouldn't be... it feels like the ground's shifting under everyone, and nobody's saying why. I'm not one to complain, but I'd be lying if I said I didn't lie awake wondering if we're all gonna be okay. Family's gone, so this neighborhood's what I've got left to look after.” — Marcus Wright, Server, West Oakland (own page, the night page, C112)
